external_collaboration.evidence_quote: One illustrative activity is the Green Phoenix Project (GPP), a collaboration with Waseda University’s Governance & Sustainability Research Institute. The two entities created an industry-government-academia learning community, uniting executives from over 42 corporations (as of the end of February 2026). network.stated_total_quote: The Future Co-creation Initiative embraces internal collaborators from the Yokogawa Group, known as “Future Co-creation Supporters,” and external collaborators, known as “Future Co-creation Partners.” Team collaborators use scenario planning as a common form of communication to promote dialogue and co-creation while building a mutual network based on shared future scenarios and aspirations. The number of Future Co-creation Partners has already exceeded 130 corporations and continues to rise.
